questions.prompt: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Vectors have both magnitude and direction. Velocity has direction (e.g., 30 m/s east). Mass, temperature, and time are scalars — they have magnitude only.

questions.prompt: Two vectors of magnitudes 3 and 4 are perpendicular. What is the magnitude of their sum?
questions.explanation: For perpendicular vectors the resultant magnitude is sqrt(3² + 4²) = sqrt(25) = 5. This is the classic 3-4-5 right triangle.

questions.prompt: A vector of magnitude 10 makes an angle of 30° with the x-axis. What is its x-component?
questions.explanation: The x-component is the projection onto the x-axis: Aₓ = A cos θ = 10 × cos 30° ≈ 8.66. (Aᵧ = A sin θ = 5 would be the y-component.)
